annotations.title: Network activity and the x402 agent part, over the same days

description: WHAT EACH NETWORK CARRIED, AND THE x402 AGENT PART BESIDE IT. Per network and in totals, over a day, week, month, quarter and year: chain transactions, active addresses (a daily average beyond a week) and DEX volume from public sources (growthepie, Blockscout, DefiLlama), set beside the x402 payments we index. With chain=, the daily series too. THREE CAVEATS TO QUOTE: (1) `agentVolumeVsDex` is agentVolumeSameDays / dexVolumeSameDays, both summed over the SAME days, agentObservedStart to agentObservedEnd, the days our x402 index was reading; `dexVolumeUsd` is the whole window and is not its denominator. `agentVolumeVsDexBasis` says same_days, partial_window or none, and `agentCoverage` how much of the window was observed. Over one network the totals equal the network. (2) Payment volume and DEX trading are two different activities: a comparison, never a share. (3) x402 is not all agent activity: ACP, Olas and payments we cannot tie to x402 are not in it. Agent payers are set beside active addresses, never as a share (a payer signs, a facilitator sends). A network a source does not cover is null, never zero. `coverage` names the population (network_activity_days). Free.

chain.description: One network, e.g. ethereum or base; adds the daily series. Omit for every network.

name: network_activity

asOf.description: The end day, null where nothing has been read.

endDay.description: The last complete day the windows end on (each network ends on its own last counted day, `windowEndDay`).

meta.description: How current this answer is and what it was read from: `freshness` and the ages behind it. Present on every answer from this server, whatever the tool.

networks.description: Per network: chain, windowEndDay, windows[] (window, days, txCount, agentTx, agentTxShare, agentTxBasis, agentCoverage, activeAddresses, agentActive, dexVolumeUsd, agentVolumeUsd, agentVolumeVsDex, agentVolumeVsDexMeans, agentVolumeVsDexBasis, agentVolumeSameDays, dexVolumeSameDays, periodStart, periodEnd, agentObservedStart, agentObservedEnd), sourcesCovered, and with chain= the daily series.

totals.description: Across networks, by window, with the same same-days ratio and period fields as each network.

totalsMeans.description: How the totals add: an address active on two networks counts twice.

uniquesAt.description: When the unique-payer windows were counted.

warnings.description: Anything the server wants a caller to know about THIS answer before acting on it, each {code, message, says} with message and says the same sentence. Empty is the normal case and is not a guarantee.
